payload.scope: Chronological capture log for the nine current unique Xbox screen recordings.

selectionPolicy.incidentalVisibility: Neighboring thumbnails, swatches, cards, and context labels are retained as notes or visibleNonSelectedLabels but are not promoted to selected catalog records.
selectionPolicy.selectedOptions: Only events with direct selected-state UI evidence are treated as deliberate option selections.
selectionPolicy.uncertainty: Candidate linkage records whether the match came from overlapping evidence, label fallback, or no candidate package record.
